Real-score regression fixtures from OpenScore Lieder, downloaded 2026-10-12.
The encodings are dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0; see LICENSE.txt.

- Jane Bingham Abbott, *Just for Today*: https://github.com/OpenScore/Lieder/blob/main/scores/Abbott,_Jane_Bingham/_/Just_for_Today/lc6583477.mxl
- Harriett Abrams, *Crazy Jane*: https://github.com/OpenScore/Lieder/blob/main/scores/Abrams,_Harriett/_/Crazy_Jane/lc6583907.mxl

These are complete, unmodified XML members extracted from the upstream MXL archives.
Tests pin voice/note/bar counts, continuity, pickups and low notes. They are playback
regressions, not a claim that inferred harmony or generated guitar fingerings are calibrated.

`meter-voices.musicxml` is an original synthetic regression fixture for meter changes, ties, simultaneous pitches and subdivisions.
